comment: Sample streams and the alert events they must raise, run by the app's engine (health/tests.rs) and by the node agent's (agent/agent_test.py), so both page at the same moments. Step n is n seconds in; each segment holds its value for `secs` steps. Expected: [step, event, severity]. A roce case gives per-second counter increments (perS) instead of a value; rates come from fabric::rates (10 s now, a full 60 s for sustained counters). Cases marked macOnly are about this Mac (its path to the cluster, its login to a node): a state segment sets the snapshot's mac_reach state (metric macReach) or the first node's error kind (errorKind, null for online); agent_test.py skips them.

cases.name: memory warns after a minute at 90%, escalates at 95%, eases above the clear line, clears below 88%
a memory spike to 97% is critical within two readings
a disk at the 85% line warns at once and holds above 83%
a hot GPU warns after two minutes and clears 30 s after it's below 82 °C
a short GPU spike never fires
clock offset beyond 100 ms either way warns, beyond 1 s is critical
roce-loss then recovery: CRC errors raise at once, critical; it clears 30 s after the counters stop moving
out-of-sequence must average past 1/s over a full minute: a one-second burst doesn't raise; 2/s does once the minute's average passes 1/s
this Mac losing the LAN is one warning at once, cleared 10 s after it reaches the cluster again
an untrusted host key is information at once, never an outage, and goes when the key is trusted
